metadata.frameworks-applied: UCE34, COCA, ASSUM, T28, B32, I20

strengths.strength: Comprehensive testing (107+ T28 tests, all 4 tiers)
Excellent documentation (UCE34 Q1-Q34 analysis in modules)

concerns.concern: Code duplication in demo tier execution (3 locations)
Event type explosion in audit system (25+ event types)

issue.title: Demo Tier Execution - Severe Code Duplication
issue.description: The `generate_synthetic_corpus()` function is duplicated across 3 locations with identical logic (exact duplicates 5%, near-duplicates 15%, unique 80%). This violates DRY principle and creates maintenance burden.

impact.risk: Bug fixes must be applied in 3 places (error-prone)
impact.maintenance: 3× maintenance overhead for corpus generation changes
impact.size: ~300 lines of duplicate code (97 lines × 3 files)

recommendation.solution: Extract to `benchmarking::corpus_generation::generate_synthetic_corpus()`

migration.step: 3. Replace all 3 call sites with module import
4. Add property tests for corpus generation invariants

uce34-violation.question: Q28: Simplicity
uce34-violation.analysis: Code duplication increases cognitive load and maintenance burden

issue.title: Hardcoded Optimization Parameters - No Configuration Layer
issue.description: Critical optimization parameters are hardcoded throughout the codebase with no configuration layer. This violates UCE34 Q32 (Constraints) and makes tuning for different hardware profiles impossible without recompilation.

impact.risk: Optimal settings for Ryzen 9 6900HX may be suboptimal for other CPUs
impact.maintenance: Parameter tuning requires code changes + recompilation
impact.production: Cannot adapt to different deployment environments

recommendation.solution: Create unified OptimizationConfig capsule with runtime tuning

migration.step: 3. Replace all hardcoded constants with config fields
4. Add property tests for config validation
5. Document optimal settings for common hardware

uce34-violation.question: Q32: Constraints
uce34-violation.analysis: Hardcoded parameters ignore deployment constraints and hardware diversity

issue.title: StreamingCorpusGenerator - Documented But Missing
issue.description: CLAUDE.md documentation references StreamingCorpusGenerator for memory-efficient corpus generation, but implementation is incomplete or missing. This creates documentation-code mismatch and limits large-scale testing capability.

impact.risk: Documentation promises feature that doesn't exist
impact.memory: Current corpus generation loads all docs in RAM

recommendation.solution: Either implement StreamingCorpusGenerator OR remove documentation references

if-remove.action: Update CLAUDE.md to reflect current capabilities
Document future roadmap item for streaming generation

uce34-violation.question: Q29: Documentation
uce34-violation.analysis: Documentation-code mismatch creates confusion and false expectations

issue.title: Audit Event Type Explosion - 25+ Event Types
issue.description: The audit system has grown to 25+ distinct event types, creating maintenance burden and making it difficult to reason about audit coverage. Many event types are single-use or rarely triggered.

usage-frequency.low-usage: 12+ types (5% of events, some never triggered)

impact.maintenance: Adding new event types requires 5+ file changes
impact.complexity: Event handler logic scattered across multiple modules
impact.testing: Difficult to achieve 100% event type coverage

recommendation.solution: Consolidate to 5-7 core event categories with metadata fields

benefits.benefit: Easier to reason about audit coverage

migration.step: 2. Map existing 25+ types to 5 categories + metadata

uce34-violation.question: Q28: Simplicity
uce34-violation.analysis: 25+ event types create unnecessary complexity, violates simplicity principle

issue.title: Dashboard Thread Safety - Unverified Assumptions
issue.description: AuditDashboard relies on indicatif MultiProgress being Send+Sync, but this is documented as #ASSUME without executable #VERIFY test. ASSUM framework requires every assumption to have corresponding verification.

test-coverage.verification: Compiler check only (no runtime stress test)

impact.risk: Potential race conditions under heavy concurrent updates
impact.assum: ASSUM framework violation (assumption without runtime verification)

recommendation.solution: Add multi-threaded property test for dashboard thread safety

assum-violation.missing: Runtime stress test for indicatif thread safety

issue.title: Test Fixture Duplication Across Test Files

location.lines: Similar test corpus generation in all files

issue.description: Test corpus generation and fixture setup is duplicated across 15+ test files. Each file reimplements corpus generation with similar logic, violating DRY.

impact.maintenance: Test fixture changes must be applied in 12+ files
impact.consistency: Risk of test fixture divergence over time

recommendation.solution: Extract to tests/common/fixtures.rs shared module

migration.step: 2. Move all test fixture generation logic
3. Replace all 12+ call sites with module import
4. Add documentation for test fixture patterns

uce34-violation.question: Q28: Simplicity
uce34-violation.analysis: Test code duplication increases maintenance burden

issue.title: Dashboard Update Rate Limiting - Hardcoded 1 Second
issue.description: Dashboard update rate is hardcoded to 1-second minimum interval in documentation, but no actual rate limiting code exists. For 10M+ document demos, 1-second updates may be too frequent (100 updates) or too infrequent (poor UX).

implementation.code: No actual rate limiting in update_progress() implementation

impact.performance: Excessive updates waste CPU on large demos
impact.ux: Poor responsiveness perception for fast operations

recommendation.solution: Implement adaptive rate limiting based on operation duration

issue.title: Phase Documentation Files - Orphaned and Outdated
issue.description: Multiple PHASE*.md documentation files exist but may be outdated or redundant with CLAUDE.md. No clear indication of which phase docs are current vs. historical.

evidence.file-count: 15+ PHASE*.md files in docs/ and benches/

impact.maintenance: Multiple docs require updates for same changes

recommendation.solution: Consolidate or archive outdated phase documentation

options.option: 1. Move historical phase docs to docs/archive/
3. Update CLAUDE.md to reference current vs. archived docs

issue.title: Demo Command - Inconsistent Error Handling
issue.description: Demo command uses Box<dyn Error> instead of proper error types, losing error context and making recovery difficult.

recommendation.solution: Create DemoError enum with thiserror

design.code:
#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)] pub enum DemoError { #[error("Corpus generation failed: {0}")] CorpusGeneration(String),
#[error("Pipeline execution failed: {0}")] PipelineExecution(#[from] crate::Error),
#[error("Ground truth computation failed: {0}")] GroundTruth(String),
#[error("Resource validation failed: {0}")] ResourceValidation(String), }

issue.title: Protection Status Polling - Excessive Overhead
issue.description: Protection status checking frequency is not documented or configurable. Excessive polling may waste CPU cycles.

recommendation.solution: Document optimal polling frequency and add configuration

issue.title: Benchmark Result Storage - No Persistent History
issue.description: Benchmark results are not persistently stored for regression analysis. Cannot track performance evolution over time.

recommendation.solution: Implement benchmark result history with git integration

issue.title: Module Structure - Flat Hierarchy in src/
issue.description: Source directory has relatively flat hierarchy with 174 files. Could benefit from better module organization into feature-based subdirectories.

recommendation.solution: Reorganize into feature-based modules

issue.title: Inconsistent Naming - "Phase" vs "Week" Prefixes
issue.description: Test and benchmark files use inconsistent prefixes ("phase" vs "week"), creating confusion about organizational scheme.

recommendation.solution: Standardize on single naming scheme (prefer "phase")

issue.title: Missing High-Level Architecture Diagram
issue.description: No visual architecture diagram showing tier composition and data flow. Would help onboarding and system understanding.

recommendation.solution: Create docs/ARCHITECTURE.md with ASCII/Mermaid diagrams

issue.title: Property Test Coverage - Limited Generators
issue.description: Property tests use simple random generators. Could benefit from more sophisticated corpus generators (QuickCheck/Proptest patterns).

recommendation.solution: Enhance property test generators with domain-specific strategies

issue.title: Corpus Generation - Parallel Efficiency Not Validated
issue.description: Parallel corpus generation uses rayon but efficiency not benchmarked. May have suboptimal parallelization for small corpus sizes.

recommendation.solution: Add B32 benchmark for corpus generation scaling

issue.title: Color Scheme - ANSI Approximation of Byzantine Purple
issue.description: Byzantine purple (#702963) approximated with ANSI magenta. True color terminals could display actual Byzantine purple.

recommendation.solution: Add true color support with fallback to ANSI

issue.title: Audit Trail - No Automatic Rotation
issue.description: Audit log files grow unbounded with no automatic rotation. Long-running systems may accumulate large audit files.

recommendation.solution: Implement log rotation with size/time-based policies

issue.title: No Prometheus/StatsD Integration
issue.description: Metrics are logged but not exported to monitoring systems. Production deployments would benefit from Prometheus integration.

recommendation.solution: Add optional metrics export feature

issue.title: CLI Help Text - No Examples Section
issue.description: CLI help text lacks concrete usage examples. Users must discover correct usage through trial and error.

recommendation.solution: Add examples section to CLI help (clap after_help)

issue.title: Integration Tests - No Docker Compose Setup
issue.description: Integration tests assume local environment. No containerized test environment for reproducibility.

recommendation.solution: Create docker-compose.yml for test environment

issue.title: indicatif Dependency - Not Fully Audited
issue.description: indicatif crate used for progress bars but ASSUM assumptions not fully verified with property tests.

recommendation.solution: Add comprehensive property tests for indicatif usage

issue.title: No CI/CD Pipeline Definition
issue.description: No GitHub Actions workflow for automated testing and benchmarking. Manual testing increases risk of regression.

recommendation.solution: Create GitHub Actions workflow for CI/CD

opportunity.title: Unified Tier Result Type
opportunity.description: AccuracyResults and ScaleResults share similar fields. Could be unified into single TierResult<T> generic type.
opportunity.benefit: Reduce code duplication, simplify result handling

opportunity.title: CorpusGenerator Trait
opportunity.description: Multiple corpus generation functions could implement common trait, enabling polymorphism and easier testing.

opportunity.title: Lazy Configuration Initialization
opportunity.description: OptimizationConfig could use lazy_static or OnceCell for zero-cost initialization on first use.
opportunity.benefit: Eliminate runtime overhead for unused features

metric.name: Documentation
metric.rating: SILVER (excellent inline docs, could improve architecture docs)

priority-1.recommended-order: P1-001 (audit events), P1-002 (dashboard tests), P1-003 (test fixtures)

immediate-actions.action: Address P0-001 (corpus generation duplication) to reduce maintenance burden
Address P1-001 (audit event consolidation) to simplify audit system

long-term-actions.action: Address P2 issues during feature development

maintenance-strategy.guideline: Prevent new duplication by enforcing code review checklist
Require configuration layer for all optimization parameters
Mandate ASSUM verification tests for all assumptions
Enforce shared test fixtures via common module

conclusion.overall-assessment: The kindly_dedup codebase demonstrates EXCELLENT code quality with minimal technical debt. The implementation is production-ready with strong framework compliance (UCE34, COCA, ASSUM, T28, B32, I20). The identified issues are primarily organizational (code duplication, configuration management) rather than fundamental design flaws.

priority-fixes.fix: P0-002: Create OptimizationConfig layer (critical for production)
P0-001: Eliminate corpus generation duplication (maintenance burden)
P1-001: Consolidate audit event types (complexity reduction)

conclusion.recommendation: Proceed with production deployment after addressing P0 issues (12-18 hours effort). Schedule P1 issues for next sprint. P2 issues can be addressed opportunistically during feature development.
